claim: DataFoundry persists the run event before applying checkpoint/trace projections and delivering the same ordered event to the UI.
DataFoundry Continue from here creates a child session from a rollbackable checkpoint instead of mutating the original session.
LangGraph persists state checkpoints by thread and supports interrupt/resume plus replay or fork from historical checkpoints.
Agent frontends benefit from typed lifecycle, step, message, tool and state events rather than deriving all UI state from text.
DB-GPT separates read-only SQL execution from other tools and stores complete tool results separately from compact model context.
Checkpoint deserialization requires a strict security boundary; ForgeSight therefore specifies versioned JSON allowlists and rejects arbitrary object serialization.
